hero.comment: HOME-01 and HOME-02. Both are the drafts from brief §6.1.1, which the slot map lists as the fallback that ships. Subhead is split into two paragraphs to match the hero rhythm in the §6.1.1 layout, where 'I teach them…' sits as its own beat.
hero.headline: words are not flat.
subhead: they have grain, weight, and a way of changing the person who receives them.
I teach them, voice them, and reshape them.

paragraphs: A first-class degree in English and American literature. A Trinity CertTESOL, a PGCE, and qualified teacher status. Years teaching for the British Council in Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
